scenarioSurface.notes:
A provider name or provider-slot node is not complete design authority. Every
  provider-bearing canonical blueprint candidate must bind attributable,
  freshness-qualified evidence for the exact operation, native and canonical
  contracts, mappings, semantics, scenario responsibility, effects,
  authorization, conformance, target realization, precedent, and selection it
  proposes before mechanic feasibility or human review.

  The qualification is pure. It consumes exact declarative products, recomputes
  their identities, compares their relationships, and returns evidence. It
  invokes no provider, performs no external effect, selects no candidate,
  repairs no blueprint, creates no adapter, requests no review, and admits no
  authority.

  Provider evidence has four orthogonal classes: shape observation, published
  semantics, scenario-fit hypothesis, and admitted or rejected precedent.
  Observation and inference may nominate a candidate but cannot select, approve,
  admit, or authorize it. Shape compatibility alone cannot authorize a native
  to canonical mapping, and absence of an observed effect cannot prove purity.

  A provider-bearing candidate closes only when every expected provider slot has
  exactly one verified coverage row and binds either one exact selected
  operation or one closed deterministic provider profile. Every eligible member
  of a closed profile independently closes the same semantic, contract, effect,
  authorization, conformance, and target obligations.

  A genuinely provider-free blueprint is explicit. NOT_APPLICABLE requires
  independent proof of zero provider slots, zero effect boundaries requiring a
  provider, and zero dependency edges delegating the responsibility to a
  provider. Missing evidence is never normalized to NOT_APPLICABLE or zero
  findings.

  In the semantic-carrier compiler lane, provider meaning, selection or closed
  profile, canonical contracts, and immutable evidence references must exist
  before blackout. Qualification may resolve those references but cannot invent
  or complete provider meaning after blackout. A missing fact holds with no
  AUTHOR fallback.

  Every result is bound to one frozen provider-candidate generation and the
  exact blueprint candidate. Repeated qualification from the same frozen bytes
  must produce byte-identical coverage, findings, disposition, and receipt.
